_scope: Bāla 18–21, the range covered by films M1–M7. Read verse by verse against the roster.
_rule: Nothing here is added automatically. It is audited material for the studio and the editor.

MISSING_ESSENTIAL.what: The sage demands a re-commitment BEFORE asking: "be true to your promise"
MISSING_ESSENTIAL.why: It is the setup of the trap. Without it M2 plays as an ambush; with it the king walks in with his eyes open.

MISSING_ESSENTIAL.what: The sage names Vasiṣṭha as someone who knows Rāma's worth, and says: if your ministers led by Vasiṣṭha agree, send him
MISSING_ESSENTIAL.why: This is WHY Vasiṣṭha speaks in M6. Without it, his intervention arrives unmotivated for a new viewer.

MISSING_USEFUL.what: "Be happy with your kin, you who broke your word" — the sage's parting sarcasm
MISSING_USEFUL.why: ⟨Bāla 20.3, GRETIL — text withheld⟩. The most devastating line in the arc, and we cut it.

MISSING_USEFUL.what: "Whether trained in weapons or not, the rākṣasas cannot harm him"
MISSING_USEFUL.why: Vasiṣṭha answers the father's exact objection from M3 (akṛtavidya). A callback the source already wrote.

MISSING_USEFUL.what: The king offers to go WITH the army and his four sons, and says he got Rāma with difficulty at great age
MISSING_USEFUL.why: Deepens the father without inventing anything.

MISSING_USEFUL.what: The sage tells Rāma to touch water before receiving the mantras
MISSING_USEFUL.why: A ritual gesture, specific and filmable, for M8.

DELIBERATELY_OMITTED.what: Rain of flowers, divine drums and conches as they depart
DELIBERATELY_OMITTED.why: OMITTED BY DIRECTION, not by oversight. M7 plays the departure plain on purpose. But it IS in the text, and a knowledgeable viewer will know it. Declared here; Ask must answer it.
DELIBERATELY_OMITTED.class: the text has a miraculous register here that our staging chooses not to render

DELIBERATELY_OMITTED.what: Vasiṣṭha's account of the sage's divine weapons, the sons of Kṛśāśva
DELIBERATELY_OMITTED.why: Rich but expository. Belongs to arc 9, when the weapons are actually given.

UNVERIFIED_IN_THE_FILMS.what: M1: "The king came down from his seat to meet him"
UNVERIFIED_IN_THE_FILMS.why: The reception is in sarga 17, which is NOT loaded. Dutt XVIII is held only as a one-passage extract. This line is currently unsourced in this workspace — treat as staging until 17 is read.
